correctness.rationale: First-hit decomposition into the earliest target plus suffix overlap gives H(z,y)=[1+(1−sum_a t_a) sum_{border ell}p(prefix_ell)^(-1)]^-1 with t_a=zy_a/s. Differentiating marker a minus b, followed by 1/tau=integral_0^1 z^(tau-1) dz, gives an exact signed integral for E[(N_a−N_b)/tau] with positive kernel. Let L be longest border with nonzero difference d_L. Shorter prefix differences change by at most their length offset, so the bracket is bounded below by 1−t^2/(1−t)^2>0 for t=z/s<1/2 and d_L>=1. Thus every pair sign and all ties follow; strict inequality holds for s>=2. The balance iff uniform all letters follows from sum Q_a=1.

value.rationale: For a stopped i.i.d. sequence, E[N_a/tau] is a natural yet nontrivial composition statistic; a complete s-symbol weak ranking and all tie conditions (not only binary imbalance) are determined by overlap combinatorics without computing s separate expectations. A balanced target can still bias its stopped sample, making the classification meaningful for multisymbol patterns. The all-symbol consequence is more than renaming one binary statistic.
